title: Outer Wilds Discs
description: Adds Music discs from out of this world!
body:
Adds music discs from the game Outer Wilds. First, If you have not played Outer Wilds I recommend you play that first, The game is recommended to be played blind and the songs count as spoilers (Yea thats right).

It adds

- A new Noami Structure
- 15 music discs and thats about it.

You can find these music discs in the new structure. The strucure itself has three varients.

If you have any recomendations, please put them in the comments

(WARNING THIS MOD HAS DLC MUSIC IN IT AS WELL).

I have a mod here that has no DLC music

ALSO NOT MY MUSIC!!!

The music here is owned and made by Andrew Prahlow and has full rights to the music. Go give him and Mobius digital support.
